source_caption:
🎬 Serenity (2019)

Serenity follows Baker Dill, a troubled fishing boat captain living on the beautiful but isolated island of Plymouth, where he spends his days taking tourists on fishing trips while obsessively pursuing a giant tuna that continues to escape him. Although his surroundings appear peaceful, Baker struggles with painful memories, emotional isolation, and a mysterious past that he cannot escape. His quiet life takes a dramatic turn when his former wife, Karen, unexpectedly arrives with a disturbing request. Trapped in an abusive marriage to a wealthy and violent man named Frank, Karen begs Baker to help her escape by taking Frank on a fishing trip and throwing him overboard, making his death appear accidental. Desperate to protect their young son, Patrick, she offers Baker a large sum of money to carry out the plan. As Baker wrestles with the moral consequences of her proposal, strange events begin unfolding around him, making him question the reality of his surroundings and the people he encounters. Meanwhile, mysterious connections between his past and present gradually emerge, revealing that his situation is far more complicated than it initially appears. As the tension builds, Baker must confront difficult choices involving revenge, love, responsibility, and the nature of reality itself. Combining psychological suspense, unexpected twists, emotional drama, and mysterious storytelling, the film explores guilt, grief, family, morality, and the blurred boundaries between reality and imagination.

🎭 Genre: Mystery • Thriller • Drama

⭐ IMDb: 5.4/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 46m • R

🎥 Director: Steven Knight

source_details.synopsis: Serenity is a 2019 American mystery thriller film written, produced and directed by Steven Knight. The film stars Matthew McConaughey, Anne Hathaway, Diane Lane, Jason Clarke, Djimon Hounsou, and Jeremy Strong, and follows a fishing boat captain who is approached by his ex-wife to murder her abusive new husband. First announced in January 2017, principal photography on the film began in Mauritius that July. Serenity was released in the United States on January 25, 2019, by Aviron Pictures. Following poor test screenings, its distributor abruptly dropped its marketing efforts and the film was a critical and commercial failure.
